requirements.title: View room availability
requirements.text: The system shall let a user see which active meeting rooms are free for a chosen date and time range, showing each room's name, capacity, floor and equipment.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a date and time range, rooms with no booking overlapping that range are listed as free
Rooms with an overlapping booking are not shown as free
Each listed room shows name, capacity, floor and equipment
Deactivated rooms are not listed as bookable

requirements.title: Book a room
requirements.text: The system shall let a user book a free, active room for a chosen time slot.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can create a booking for a free room with a start and end time
The new booking appears in the room's schedule and in the user's bookings
Booking a deactivated room is rejected

requirements.title: No overlapping bookings
requirements.text: The system shall reject any booking or booking change that overlaps in time with an existing booking for the same room.
acceptanceCriteria: A booking whose time range overlaps an existing booking for the same room is rejected with an error message
Two simultaneous requests for the same room and overlapping time result in only one stored booking
Bookings in different rooms at the same time are allowed
A booking that starts exactly when another ends in the same room is allowed

requirements.title: Cancel own booking
requirements.text: The system shall let a user cancel their own bookings.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can cancel a booking they created
After cancellation the time slot is shown as free
A user cannot cancel another user's booking

requirements.title: Admin manages rooms
requirements.text: The system shall let an admin add and edit rooms and delete rooms that have no future bookings.
acceptanceCriteria: An admin can add a room with name, capacity, floor and equipment list, and it becomes available for booking
An admin can edit a room's name, capacity, floor and equipment
An admin can delete a room that has no future bookings
Deleting a room with one or more future bookings is rejected with an error message
Non-admin users cannot perform these actions

requirements.title: Browser-based
requirements.text: The system shall be usable in a web browser without installing client software.
acceptanceCriteria: All user and admin functions are accessible through a web browser

requirements.title: Time slot rules
requirements.text: The system shall accept only bookings whose start and end fall on 15-minute steps, last 15 minutes to 4 hours, lie within 07:00 to 20:00 on a weekday, and start no more than 60 days ahead.
acceptanceCriteria: A booking with a start or end not on a 15-minute step is rejected
A booking shorter than 15 minutes or longer than 4 hours is rejected
A booking outside 07:00-20:00 or on a Saturday or Sunday is rejected
A booking starting more than 60 days ahead is rejected
A valid 15-minute booking and a valid 4-hour booking are accepted

requirements.title: Name and email identity
requirements.text: The system shall ask a user for name and email once, store them in the browser, and attach them to bookings the user creates, without a sign-in.
acceptanceCriteria: On first use the user is asked for name and email
On later visits in the same browser the user is not asked again
Each booking shows the name and email of its creator
Booking is not possible until name and email are provided

requirements.title: Admin password access
requirements.text: The system shall grant admin functions only to a user who enters the admin password configured in an environment variable.
acceptanceCriteria: Entering the correct password enables admin functions
Entering a wrong password does not enable admin functions
Admin actions called without valid admin authentication are rejected by the server
The password is read from an environment variable and is not stored in the source code

requirements.title: Change own booking time
requirements.text: The system shall let a user change the start and end time of their own booking, applying the same time slot and overlap rules as for new bookings.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can change the time of their own booking to a free valid slot in the same room
A change that violates the overlap rule or time slot rules is rejected and the original booking stays unchanged
A user cannot change another user's booking

requirements.title: Admin cancels any booking
requirements.text: The system shall let an admin cancel any user's booking.
acceptanceCriteria: An admin can cancel a booking created by any user
After cancellation the time slot is shown as free

requirements.title: Deactivate room
requirements.text: The system shall let an admin deactivate and reactivate a room, where a deactivated room accepts no new bookings.
acceptanceCriteria: An admin can deactivate a room
New bookings for a deactivated room are rejected
A room with future bookings can be deactivated
An admin can reactivate a deactivated room and it accepts bookings again

openQuestions.text: Since there is no sign-in, a booking's owner is identified by the name and email saved in the browser. Is it acceptable that a user who clears browser data or switches browser cannot cancel or change their own bookings (only an admin can)? Or should there be another way, such as a cancellation link sent by email?
Which time zone applies to the 07:00-20:00 bookable hours, and is a booking allowed to end exactly at 20:00?
What should happen to existing future bookings when a room is deactivated: do they stay valid, or are they cancelled?
Can users cancel or change bookings that have already started or ended, and can they book a slot that starts in the past?

outOfScope: Real user sign-in (SSO or per-user accounts)
Individual admin accounts or role management (single shared admin password only)
